title: The kernel of a normalized colimit graded-piece map is a finite alpha pullback
statement: Let C be an abelian category, X a type-zero bigraded exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple] with E(p,q)=0 for p<0, and A(n) alpha colimits [def-sp-convergence] normalized by A(n).obj=D(0,n) and transported identity zeroth maps. For r natural and p,q integers with p<=r, the kernel of toGradedPiece from D(p,q) to the pth graded piece [def-sp-filtration] of A(p+q) is the pullback along alphaIter r of image(incomingAlphaIter(r+1) at (p-r,q+r)). This statement does not refer to finite page E or its cycle projection.

proof.text: For any nested subobjects S<=R and any map e into R, the kernel of e followed by the cokernel projection of S into R is the inverse image of S along e followed by R.arrow. Prove both subobject inequalities by Factors tests, using Abelian.monoLift for the implication from annihilation by the cokernel and mono cancellation for its converse.

Reuse alpha_iso_left from HalfPlaneDiagonalColimits for invertibility of alpha at nonpositive first index. Starting from the normalized zeroth cocone map, induct through the cocone equation to show all nonpositive cocone maps invertible. Induction on alphaIter gives its cocone equation; expanding incomingAlphaIter gives its analogous equation.

Put u=p-r, v=q+r and let c be the invertible cocone map at (u,v) with transport. The iterate equations say alphaIter r followed by c is transported iota_p, while incomingAlphaIter(r+1) followed by c is transported iota_(p+1). Apply the first step to the explicit image quotient defining toGradedPiece. An epi-mono image factorization identifies the next filtration step with the image of incomingAlphaIter transported through c. Functoriality of pullback and pullback_map_self cancel c and give the formula.

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedGraded_finite_kernel (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0)
    (hE : ∀ p q : ℤ, p < 0 → IsZero (X.E p q))
    (A : ∀ n : ℤ, AlphaColimit X n)
    (hA : ∀ n : ℤ, (A n).obj = X.D 0 n)
    (hι : ∀ n : ℤ, (A n).ι 0 ≫ eqToHom (hA n) =
      eqToHom (by congr 1; omega))
    (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ) (hp : p ≤ (r : ℤ)) :
    kernelSubobject (X.toGradedPiece A p q) =
      (Subobject.pullback (X.alphaIter r p q)).obj
        (imageSubobject (X.incomingAlphaIter (r + 1) (p - r) (q + r)))
